keywords.en: I  think I slept worng/ I must’ve slept worng
②  I think I saw it wong/ I must’ve seen it wrong
③  Maybe I read it wrong/ I think I read it wrong

I had him/her wrong

my_sentences.ko: 내 생각이 틀렸네/ 회화에서 정말 자주 쓰입니다.

my_sentences.en: I must've left it at home.

my_sentences.ko: I must've + p.p. → ~였나 봐. (I must've forgotten.)
I think I + 과거동사 + wrong. → 내가 잘못 ~한 것 같아. (I think I heard you wrong.)
I had + 사람/정보 + wrong. → 내가 ~를 잘못 알고 있었네. (I had the date wrong.)
I don't know if this is the right thing to do. → 이게 맞는 일인지 모르겠네.
I don't remember + 사람 + ever + ~ing. → 그 사람이 한 번이라도 ~했던 기억이 없어. (I don't remember her ever complaining.)
